```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Verify Controller Reports Proximal Tube Connection",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-103"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {"controller_status": "connected"},
    "steps": [
      "Initiate connection to the proximal tube via the controller API.",
      "Assert that the controller API returns a connected status.",
      "Check the system logs for a confirmation of the connection."
    ],
    "expected": ["The controller should report a connected status for the proximal tube."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Verify Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-104"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["The proximal tube is disconnected"],
    "inputs": {"disconnect_status": true},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the disconnect function on the controller.",
      "Assert that the 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm is activated.",
      "Check the alarm system for the 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm status."
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm should be active."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Verify Medium Priority of Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-105"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the alarm priority function with 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm.",
      "Assert that the alarm priority level is medium."
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm should have a medium priority level."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Verify Obstruction Alarm Activation When Obstruction Detected",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-107"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Obstruction detected (VTI < 100ml)"],
    "inputs": {"obstruction_detected": true},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the obstruction alarm function.",
      "Assert that the 'obstruction' alarm is activated.",
      "Check the alarm system for the 'obstruction' alarm status."
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'obstruction' alarm should be active."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Verify Obstruction Alarm Deactivation When No Obstruction Detected",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-107"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["No obstruction detected (VTI >= 100ml)"],
    "inputs": {"obstruction_detected": false},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the obstruction alarm function.",
      "Assert that the 'obstruction' alarm is not activated.",
      "Check the alarm system for the 'obstruction' alarm status."
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'obstruction' alarm should not be active."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Verify High Priority of Obstruction Alarm",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-109"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the alarm priority function with 'obstruction' alarm.",
      "Assert that the alarm priority level is high."
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'obstruction' alarm should have a high priority level."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-007",
    "title": "Verify GUI Computation of Leakage Amount Based on Sensor Readings",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-110"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Sensor readings are available"],
    "inputs": {"sensor_readings": {"volume": 50, "time": "10:00 AM"}},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the leakage computation function with the provided sensor readings.",
      "Assert that the function returns the correct leakage rate (L/min).",
      "Check the GUI for the displayed leakage rate."
    ],
    "expected": ["The GUI should display the correct leakage rate based on the sensor readings."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-008",
    "title": "Boundary Test for Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm Priority",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-105"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the alarm priority function with 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm.",
      "Assert that the alarm priority is at its boundary condition (e.g., just below medium priority)."

    "expected": ["The 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm should be at its boundary priority level."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-009",
    "title": "Boundary Test for Obstruction Alarm Priority",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-109"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the alarm priority function with 'obstruction' alarm.",
      "Assert that the alarm priority is at its boundary condition (e.g., just below high priority)."
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'obstruction' alarm should be at its boundary priority level."]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-100",
    "title": "Negative Test Case for Non-Existent Alarm Priority",
    "req_ids": ["U09_Alarms-RW-SW-105", "U09_Alarms-RW-SW-109"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Invoke the alarm priority function with 'proximal tube disconnect' and 'obstruction' alarms.",
      "Assert that the system raises an exception for non-existent alarm priority."
    ],
    "expected": ["An exception should be raised for non-existent alarm priority."]
  }
]
```

Note: The actual implementation of the test cases would depend on the specific testing framework being used (e.g., pytest, unittest, NUnit, etc.), and the details of the system under test. The JSON format provided here is a generic representation that can be adapted to fit the chosen framework. The "expected" fields should be concrete outcomes derived from the requirement text, and the "preconditions" should be set up based on the context of the requirement. The "steps" should include actions to perform the test and the assertions to check the expected behavior. The "kind" field indicates whether the test is a positive test (verifying that the system behaves as expected), a negative test (verifying that the system handles incorrect inputs or states correctly), or a boundary test (verifying behavior at the edge of acceptable input ranges). The "expected" fields should be specific and checkable outcomes, not invented specifics. If certain values are not specified in the requirements, they should be stated as "as specified" in the expected outcomes.
